name: tree-sitter-yaml
reason: Excluded: a tree-sitter grammar for editors. The crate exports a Language for the separate tree-sitter runtime, which returns a concrete syntax tree of token ranges; it does not decode escapes, fold block scalars or resolve aliases, so the harness would have to implement YAML loading to produce the typed tree.
